description: This is a stylized, retro-inspired television with a vibrant orange casing and a grey screen. It features two silver antennae extending upwards from the top, suggesting an older model. The design is simple and somewhat boxy, giving it a playful and nostalgic feel. The smooth, rounded edges of the casing contribute to its cartoonish aesthetic. This television appears to be a 3D rendered model, presented against a neutral grey background.
